drivers: Monday's chip-led rebound is fading: Nasdaq-100 futures −0.6% and S&P 500 futures −0.3%, with the Dow near flat, after South Korean neocloud Elice fell about 32% on its Seoul debut and revived worries about AI-infrastructure financing. Semis and neoclouds are lower (SOXX −1.4%, SK hynix −4.2%, Nebius −4.4%, CoreWeave −3.8% as HSBC reiterated its bearish debt-risk call). Deal and earnings news dominates single stocks: Salesforce agreed to buy Braze for $47.50 a share in cash (~$5.7B), GM beat but only narrowed its 2026 outlook despite a new $20B buyback, and RTX, 3M, Northrop and Halliburton rose on beats while GE Aerospace and Genuine Parts fell. Oil firmed (WTI ~$100, Brent ~$111), the 10-year yield eased to ~5.09%, and Europe and Asia were down about 1% (DAX −1.0%, Nikkei −1.3%, Hang Seng −1.3%). Netflix, Intuitive Surgical, Capital One and United report after the close; Tesla and Meta follow Wednesday.
